Ivy N: Dropping the final launch blog + short mailer + two press blurbs. Need legal quick-pass, exact UTMs, and SDR funnel routing. Target publish Wed 10am PT.

Ivy N: MAILER SUBJECT DRAFT:
```
Redwood Inference: predictable inference for production teams — webinar + try-now
```
MAILER HERO (short): Predictable latency, clearer unit economics, and flexible deployment modes for engineering teams.
CTAs:
- Try API -> https://redwood.com/signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_nov2026&utm_medium=email_hero&utm_term=try
- Register webinar -> https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_nov2026&utm_medium=email_webinar&utm_term=register
Hidden field suggestion for HubSpot: launch_bucket=nov2026_fall (for SDR segmentation).

Ivy N: BLOG LEAD DRAFT:
```
Today we launch Redwood Inference, a developer-focused inference platform built to make model serving predictable and operationally simple. It bundles a GPU-optimized runtime, workload-aware batching, KV caching, and routing policies with per-route observability and rollout controls so teams can run models reliably across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Scroll for benchmarks, methodology, and a quickstart.
```

Carlos M: Nice. Swap "operationally simple" -> "operationally pragmatic". Also add boxed link to bench methods: https://redwood.com/bench/methods-nov2026.

Renee P: Press wire blurb (~155w):
```
Redwood Inference today announces a production-grade platform for running large language model inference with consistent latency profiles and workload-aware cost controls. The platform combines an optimized serving runtime, smart routing, and KV caching to reduce variability and improve unit economics in real workloads. It supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments and includes model lifecycle tooling, canary rollouts, and per-route observability. Redwood will host a launch webinar with benchmark walkthroughs and demos. More at https://redwood.com/press
```

Renee P: Press embargo teaser (~85w):
```
Redwood Inference launches a developer-first inference platform that gives engineering teams predictable latency and clearer unit economics across hosted, dedicated, and private modes. Join our launch webinar for benchmark highlights and deployment examples.
```

Tom S: Ops note: HubSpot form exists: "Launch Trial Nov2026". Workflow created: "Launch - Trial Routing Nov2026" -> Queue: launch-nov26-sdr. Webhook for registrants set to https://hooks.redwood.com/webinar/nov. Hidden field implemented: launch_bucket=nov2026_fall. hs-bot: UTMs validated.

legal-bot: Automated quick-pass: copy approved with condition. Any numeric or comparative performance claims must appear only in the benchmark section and include a link to methodology. Avoid standalone percent claims in hero or mailer.

Ivy N: Great. Final pre-publish checklist: blog body + bench section, meta image (1200x630) w/ CTO quote, CTAs + exact UTMs, HubSpot form + hidden field, webhook test, press CSV, and social snippets (120, 240, 280 char variants). Can someone confirm meta image and webhook test?

Carlos M: Meta image + CTO quote approved. Webhook tested end-to-end; payload includes hidden field and utm params.

Renee P: Press CSV ready. Will hold embargo until publish window.

Ivy N: Locking publish window: Wed 10am PT. Ill upload final assets here and ping @channel when live. Thanks team! :sparkles:
